parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Differentiate $\sqrt{3+2\tan x}$ to obtain $\sec^2x(3+2\tan x)^{-1/2}$ - B1, OE (may be unsimplified). Not dependent on product rule, but must be convincing or isolated, not shown as the derivative of the whole expression. B0B0 for e.g. $2\sec x\sec x\tan x\sec^2x(3+2\tan x)^{-1/2}$.

Differentiate $\sec^2x$ to obtain $2\sec x\sec x\tan x$ - B1, OE. Same isolation requirement; accept e.g. $2\sin x/\cos^3x$.

Use the correct product (or quotient) rule - M1: $\sec^2x\,d(\sqrt{\cdots})/dx+\sqrt{\cdots}\,d(\sec^2x)/dx$.

Obtain derivative, if correct, $2\sec^2x\tan x(3+2\tan x)^{1/2}+\sec^4x(3+2\tan x)^{-1/2}$ and equate to zero to get an equation in one trig function - M1. Must include powers $1/2$ and $-1/2$; arithmetic errors only; may work in sines/cosines.

Obtain $5\tan^2x+6\tan x+1=0$ - A1, or equivalent forms including $5\tan^4x+6\tan^3x+6\tan^2x+6\tan x+1=0$, $52\sin^4x-28\sin^2x+1=0$, $52\cos^4x-76\cos^2x+25=0$, or $\cot^2x+6\cot x+5=0$.

Obtain AWRT $x=-0.197$ only - A1; ISW; may be more accurate.

Printed total: 6.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State $du/dx=2\sec^2x$ - B1, SOI.

Reach an integral of the form $\int A\sqrt u\,du$ - *M1, OE.

Obtain $\int\frac12u^{1/2}\,du$ - A1, OE.

Obtain $\frac13u^{3/2}$, FT their coefficient - A1FT, OE.

Substitute correct limits into $Bu^{3/2}$, or into $B(3+2\tan x)^{3/2}$ at $x=-\pi/4$ and $x=\pi/4$, and obtain $c(5^{3/2}-1^{3/2})$ - DM1, OE. Limits $u=1$ and $u=5$; do not allow only decimals.

Obtain $5\sqrt5/3-1/3$ - A1, or exact equivalent $(\sqrt{125}-1)/3$; ISW.

Printed total: 6.
